verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's FAQ states that it never uses customer code for model training and that neither CodeRabbit, OpenAI, nor Anthropic trains on your code, so the protection is on by default with no opt-out needed. Users get further control through data-retention settings, model-output logging controls, and a self-hosted Enterprise option that can opt out of all retention. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of the no-training claim, explicit coverage of non-code data (chat, learnings) under the policy, and contractual/DPA-level documentation beyond the FAQ.
